quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Jalen Brunson's suspension and his diabolical comments
quotes.excerpt: What he said yesterday was absolutely diabolical
quotes.quote: As y'all know, Jalen Brunson is on his brief 30-minute suspension. We told that nigga to stay your ass in the car until we call you. What he said yesterday was absolutely diabolical. For people who are just joining the chat, Jalen Brunson wanted to rap on the beat that we have for To The Baha. This nigga said, 'Oh don't worry guys, my crash out is coming.' He wanted to spit on it. Oh yeah, we going to crash. Listen, it's going to be a great show, great Thursday.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton on picking San Antonio in the series
quotes.excerpt: I did choose San Antonio yesterday and I got to pay my debt to Ray

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Can we clear the air though? I want the air to be cleared. I did choose San Antonio yesterday and I got to pay my debt to Ray, to my brother. But y'all vouch for me. Did I pick anybody in the series?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: No, you have not. You didn't. I'm going to give you that. He didn't. Hey guys, he didn't pick nobody to win the series, but he did pick San Antonio last night.

quotes.speaker: Hong Lau
quotes.summary_phrase: Hong Lau on the prediction market for the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: It is a prediction market. Nice and easy. You guys know prediction markets.

text_blocks.speaker: Hong Lau
text_blocks.text: It is a prediction market. Nice and easy. You guys know prediction markets. Pretty much anyone can play. It's very simple. You trade against everybody. You don't trade against the house, you trade against all your peers. I'm going to ask you guys this question. I am wrong, so I'm going to shut the hell up. How long is this series going to be done?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I still think the series is going to go at least six.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I'm going to say six for the Knicks also.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton break down the Knicks' Game 1 win
quotes.excerpt: We had OG Anunoby with 17. We had Karl-Anthony Towns with 18. We had Josh Hart with three points.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: We had OG Anunoby with 17. We had Karl-Anthony Towns with 18. We had Josh Hart with three points, but Josh Hart also had 15 rebounds and six assists. Mikal Bridges had nine points, but played stellar defense all night. Jalen Brunson, did what Jalen Brunson does. You could talk about the 12 for 31, but Jalen Brunson, me and Ray talked about it. That was a pure Knickerbocker game. It was a you had the game close, Jalen Brunson wasn't shooting well, and we are going to talk about it later. Might be one of the best closers in the game, if not the best. Mitchell Robinson, two points. Landry Shamet, 13 points off the bench. Jose Alvarado, seven points off the bench. Miles McBride, six points off the bench.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson is a bad boy.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Victor Wembanyama's performance and being overhyped
quotes.excerpt: Wemby was definitely overhyped. You could tell his adrenaline was just like he was going too fast

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: It started off Wemby on Cat. One thing I would say about Wemby, Wemby was definitely overhyped. You could tell his adrenaline was just like he was going too fast, playing too fast, and just not he put himself in such bad situations on the ball. Like you remember yesterday, we were like, 'Why is he pressed so far?' He was trying to reach to stop a handoff and guard Cat with a live dribble. Like you're automatically out of position. You know what I'm saying? And Cat did a very good job of putting his body in front of Wemby and making it tough by going to finishing and stuff. So, I'm not going to sit here and say Wemby can't guard Cat. I'm not saying that at all. That if you go back and look at the film, I wish we could play it, so then I'm not just talking out of my ass, because fuck the first finals. Wemby, you're held to a standard. You played like shit last night. You were sped up, you had six turnovers, you look you were sitting there rushing everything when you did not have to.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Dylan Harper should have been in the game at the end of the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Hong Lau
text_blocks.text: I got to ask a question. If if he said spit on the beat, is it still a deduction?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton on Victor Wembanyama's potential
quotes.excerpt: I don't determine it just by you winning a championship. If you are the best, you are the best.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: My thing is, the best player in the world to me is somebody who's it like you're not taking nobody over him. I don't determine it just by you winning a championship. If you are the best, you are the best. You might not be the best team, that does not mean so let me ask you this. What is Wemby's strength? Weak side, right? At the end of the game, Ray, this game two, it's the season. 1000%.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You lose this game, it's night night, fam.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: New York Knicks are more championship ready than San Antonio Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I think the Knicks team is more ready to win a championship right now than the Spurs are.
quotes.quote: I think he's mentally and gifted enough to respond in the right way. I think he's going to respond the rest of this series. Do I think his team is good enough to win it? Yes, but I think the Knicks are playing the best as a unit because everyone knows their role and they perfected it. Josh Hart did absolutely nothing outside of his game. Nothing. He played the perfect game that Josh Hart needed to play. Karl-Anthony Towns played the perfect way without even and think about this. This is the thing that makes it dangerous. I don't think this has to do with Wemby being the best. I don't think this has anything I think the Knicks team is more ready to win a championship right now than the Spurs are.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper should have finished the game over Devin Vassell
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper should have been in the game at the end of the game.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper should have been in the game at the end of the game. The way he was playing, you got to make a decision. I understand he's young and I want to go with a more veteran guy in Devin Vassell. Devin Vassell wasn't he didn't shoot it bad, he was four for 11. Wasn't bad, he was one for six from three though. So his three point shot wasn't falling and he rebound well, he had nine rebounds, but just could have gave a lot more. So you got to go with a guy that was actually causing a problem for the Knicks. Like this young guy was getting downhill, he was hitting shots, and he was causing havoc and he was pumped up, he was ready to go. So, as a coach, I would have made a decision to say, 'All right, I'm going to ride with this young fella at the end of this game, win, lose, or draw.' Like he's playing well, he's playing with a lot of energy. Let's see what he can do. Let's put him in his moment, see what happens. But they didn't.
